name: storeops-subagents
description: Configured sub-agent definitions for storeops Next.js development

subagents.name: security-reviewer
subagents.description: AppSec auditor reviewing diffs, PRs, Server Actions, auth checks, and OWASP Top 10 risks in Next.js applications without write permissions.

subagents.name: qa-engineer
subagents.description: Test engineer writing unit, component, API, and E2E test suites (Vitest, RTL, Playwright) in isolated workspace branches.

subagents.name: debugger
subagents.description: Root cause investigator diagnosing React hydration mismatches, RSC boundary serialization bugs, caching gotchas, and server errors.

subagents.name: architect
subagents.description: Principal architect designing App Router folder hierarchies, Data Access Layers (DAL), database schemas, state management, and ADRs.

subagents.name: doc-writer
subagents.description: Technical documentation specialist maintaining route catalogs, Server Action references, .env dictionaries, and onboarding runbooks.
